verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents automations that run on a schedule or in response to webhook events and integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear and more. Agent Canvas is described as a control center for these automations. Concrete event-triggered templates include a configurable PR-label trigger that posts a review once per label event, a Slack-mention monitor, and failed-workflow detection that opens a fix PR. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how rules and conditions are defined (filters, rule syntax, trigger configuration), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the event triggers work as described.
